description: Remove or merge duplicate records based on specified grouping fields with optional sorting

group_by_fields.info: Fields to identify duplicates - all specified fields must match to be considered duplicate
group_by_fields.field_name_desc: Name of the field to use for grouping

dedup_mode.info: Delete: keep only first record; Merge: combine non-grouping fields with separator

sort_field.info: Sort by this field before deduplication to control which record is kept

sort_order.info: Sort direction when sort field is specified

merge_separator.info: Separator for merging non-grouping field values (only used in merge mode)

errors.no_upstream_data: No upstream data available. Please connect a data source component.
errors.empty_group_fields: Grouping fields table is empty. Please add at least one field.
errors.field_not_found: Field '%{field}' not found in input data

warnings.field_load_failed: Unable to automatically load fields, please configure manually
